title: Cover Already Met on a Charge a Circle Credit Is Measured Against
content:
## What cover has already met

Where the profile holds a plan under Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans, the payouts booked on that plan
decide what cover has already met on the charge a Northbeam Circle Membership's benefit credit is measured
against.

1. Where the plan stands active or in claim hold and a payout has been booked on it in the three months
   ending on the handling day, what cover has met is the payouts booked on that plan in those three months.
2. Where that plan stands active or in claim hold, no payout stands on it in those three months and a payout
   stands on it in the twelve months ending on the handling day, what cover has met is the payouts booked on
   that plan in those twelve months.
3. Where neither of those holds, nothing is taken off for cover.

## The two windows

The nearer window runs 3 months ending on the handling day and the wider window 12 months ending on the same
day. The wider window is reached only where the nearer one carries no payout at all; where the nearer window
carries a payout, only the payouts of those three months are counted, and payouts booked earlier in the
twelve months are left out.

## Cases

A plan standing active with a payout of 300.00 booked last month and a further payout of 500.00 booked eight
months ago has 300.00 taken off for cover, not 800.00.

The same plan with its only payout booked eight months ago has 500.00 taken off for cover, because the
nearer window carries nothing and the wider window carries that payout.

A plan standing in claim hold is read exactly as one standing active. A plan standing in any other way has
nothing taken off for cover, whatever its payout entries show.
